svg.title: Enterprise Voice Agent Anti-Deepfake Liveness & Multi-Factor Telecom Authentication Architecture (Stage 373 · P739–P740)
svg.desc: Visual comparison of legacy KBA & passive voiceprint spoofing vulnerability vs P739 AASIST vocoder phase-artifact liveness detection (<=0.18 artifact threshold) + dynamic nonce challenge and P740 STIR/SHAKEN + SIM-Swap (>=72h) + FIDO2 step-up authentication.
svg.text: STAGE 373 · TOPIC 13 · P739–P740
Anti-Deepfake Liveness Detection & Multi-Factor Voice Authentication
实时防 AI 克隆声音与零摩擦电话核身架构选型：声码器相位伪影活体检测 (P739) 与运营商信令+FIDO2 阶梯鉴权 (P740)
① P739: AASIST Vocoder Phase-Artifact & Dynamic Liveness Gate
⛔ Legacy KBA + Passive-Only Voiceprint (Defeated by 3s Zero-Shot Clone)
• Attacker scrapes 3s TikTok/WeChat voice note -> runs real-time TTS voice clone
• Legacy d-vector cosine similarity scores 0.89 (matches target vocal tract timbre!)
• Plus leaked DOB/SSN answers KBA questions -> account drained in 60 seconds!
Industry Baseline: >45s KBA interrogation friction & high false-accept rate on modern neural clones
✅ P739: Sub-Band Phase Artifact (AASIST) + Dynamic Nonce Liveness
1. Why Clones Fool d-Vectors but Fail Phase Checks: Neural vocoders (HiFi-GAN/Diffusion)
match mel-spectrum amplitude but leave periodic phase discontinuities & high-freq cutoffs
2. Streaming AASIST Graph Attention (<=450ms): Flags vocoderPhaseArtifactScore > 0.18
or missing human glottal micro-tremor / acoustic pop energy
3. Dynamic Nonce Micro-Challenge: Suspect stream must read back a fresh random phrase
within <=1,200ms (exposing real-time voice-changer synthesis lag & replay attacks)
P739 Offline Policy Check: 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution;
actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic)
② P740: Telecom Attestation, SIM-Swap Cooldown & FIDO2 Step-Up
Risk-Tiered Voice Authentication Matrix
• Tier 1 (Low-Risk Read-Only): Passive STIR/SHAKEN Level-A + CAMARA Number Verify (0s friction)
• Tier 2 (Medium-Risk Account Inquiry): P739 AASIST Liveness + Enrolled d-Vector Match
Verifies caller while speaking naturally; blocks pre-recorded & zero-shot TTS clones
• Tier 3 (High-Risk Wire / SIM-Swap / Password Reset): P740 Out-of-Band FIDO2/Passkey
Never trust voice alone for wires! Require SIM-Swap >=72h + FIDO2 biometric push (<=45s)
✅ P740: Defense-in-Depth Carrier + Cryptographic Step-Up Fence
• Carrier Network Verification: Require STIR/SHAKEN Attestation-A AND carrier
SIM-swap / port-out age >= 72 hours before trusting caller ANI or SMS OTP
• Cryptographic FIDO2 / Passkey Push (<=45s window): For high-value mutations,
push a signed transaction challenge to the user's registered mobile banking app
• Zero KBA Fallback: Strictly prohibit falling back to static mother's maiden name / DOB
P740 Offline Policy Check: 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution;
actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic)
PROVENANCE & MEASUREMENT BOUNDARY DISCLOSURE (STAGE 373 · DIMENSION 376)
• Offline Policy State Machine (P739/P740): 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution; actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established (synthetic).
• Live Acoustic Anti-Spoofing DSP & Carrier CAMARA API: Real-time AASIST inference and telecom API RTT are not_measured in local unit tests.
